decisions.reason: This door lever handle family sits at the core of the firm's established fittings know-how, and in-house R&D lets it read market feedback and refine the line rather than abandon it.

This handle design builds directly on the firm's design and ergonomics expertise, so the firm can interpret its results and keep improving it, although single designs rotate out somewhat more often than families.

The electronic access system draws on the firm's existing access-control and patented engineering knowledge, was already upgraded to a Pro version, and fits the strategic move toward digital building organization.
